newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Troops of operation Jaya Sikuru kill or wound over 100 Tamil Tiger (LTTE) rebels in the battle for Omanthai on Wednesday, defence sources say. The military launched a massive offensive into the rebel-held Wanni region on Tuesday.
LTTE trying desperately to meet new British Prime Minister Tony Blair to win legal recognition in that country, defence ministry sources say.
Eighteen soldiers killed and 31 wounded in fighting in and around Omanthai, defence sources say. Over 100 rebels were also killed or wounded, they said.
Tamil civilian worker at China Bay air force base in eastern Trincomalee taken for questioning over recent LTTE attack on the installation, defence sources say.

Main opposition United National Party (UNP) MP Susantha Punchinilame and former UNP mayor of Ratnapura Mahinda Ratnatilleke and others formally charged with the killing of Nalanda Ellawala. Ellawala, a ruling People's Alliance (PA) coalition MP for the central Ratnapura area, was gunned down earlier this year.
UNP's Punchinilame and Ratnatilleke charged with killing of PA lawmaker Nalanda Ellawala earlier this year.
